name: llama.cpp 1.0: llama-server refuses to start with tools or MCP on a LAN address unless an API key is set
title: llama.cpp 1.0: llama-server refuses to start with tools or MCP on a LAN address unless an API key is set
summary: Per this post, llama.cpp 1.0 changes llama-server so serving tools or MCP on a LAN address needs an API key, or an explicit --allow-unauthenticated-tools flag for trusted networks.
